title: Default Mirror Activation shortcut conflicts with non-US keyboard layouts
author: lennartb-
summary: ZoomIt DemoMirror uses a default Ctrl+Alt+9 binding that collides with AltGr+9 character entry on German and Danish layouts; the same AltGr/Ctrl+Alt handling is already tracked in open issue #37143.

status.label: Duplicate of open AltGr tracker
status.detail: The issue is valid and now directly cross-referenced from #37143, which remains the canonical ZoomIt AltGr/Ctrl+Alt shortcut tracker.

next_action.label: Post duplicate guidance
next_action.reason: Link the open #37143 tracker and preserve the German/Danish DemoMirror evidence plus the shared conflict-detection script.

judgment.rationale: This report is a clear 0.101.2362 regression for non-US layout users, but the behavior belongs in #37143: that open issue tracks ZoomIt interpreting AltGr as Ctrl+Alt and now contains both a fresh German QWERTZ AltGr+9 report and a direct cross-reference to this issue.
evidence: The reporter says AltGr+9, needed for ] on a German layout, triggers ZoomIt DemoMirror after updating to 0.101.2362.
A Danish keyboard commenter confirms AltGr+9 triggers DemoMirror and that changing DemoMirror to Ctrl+0 moves the collision to AltGr+0.
A later commenter describes this as part of the broader class of default hotkeys assigned without non-US keyboard consideration and links a detection script.
#37143 is open, labeled Product-ZoomIt, and tracks ZoomIt activating on AltGr+key instead of Ctrl+key; it now directly cross-references this issue.
judgment.recommended_action: Post a duplicate comment pointing to #37143 while preserving this thread as additional German/Danish DemoMirror evidence.

issue_context.summary: A newly enabled/default ZoomIt DemoMirror shortcut blocks AltGr character entry on non-US layouts, and the broader AltGr-as-Ctrl+Alt behavior is already tracked in #37143.
known_information: PowerToys 0.101.2362 exposes the conflict for the reporter through ZoomIt DemoMirror.
German AltGr+9 is needed to type ].
A Danish keyboard user reproduced the same AltGr+9 conflict and showed that changing DemoMirror to Ctrl+0 causes AltGr+0 to collide with } entry.
#37143 remains open for ZoomIt AltGr/Ctrl behavior and includes a 0.101.2362 German QWERTZ AltGr+9 confirmation.
The issue timeline includes a 2026-08-31 cross-reference from #37143; there are no assignees and no maintainer decision on this issue.
inferences: The 0.101 DemoMirror default likely made an existing AltGr/Ctrl+Alt handling limitation more visible.
A fix limited to one numeric shortcut would likely miss the broader international-layout problem already tracked in #37143.
issue_context.analysis: The evidence supports duplicate handling rather than a separate design thread: the failing key chord, affected product area, recent version, and cross-referenced canonical tracker all point to the same ZoomIt AltGr interpretation problem.
initial_investigation: Forced 2026-09-02 pass read the full issue body, all three comments, current labels, empty assignee list, and timeline links.
Fetched #37143, which is open with Product-ZoomIt, Needs-Team-Response, and recent 0.101.2362 German QWERTZ AltGr+9 discussion.
Reviewed local ZoomIt ownership surface at src/modules/ZoomIt/ZoomIt/Zoomit.cpp for default shortcut handling; no linked fix PR is attached to this issue.

actions.label: Post duplicate guidance

comment.body: Thanks for the clear German-layout report and the Danish confirmation. This is the same underlying ZoomIt AltGr/Ctrl+Alt shortcut handling tracked in #37143: that issue is open for ZoomIt activating on AltGr+key, has a fresh 0.101.2362 German QWERTZ AltGr+9 report, and now directly cross-references this issue. I suggest closing this as a duplicate of #37143 while keeping this thread linked there as additional German/Danish DemoMirror evidence; the conflict-detection script shared above is also useful context for future default-hotkey checks.
